question: Which of the following is a main species of moist deciduous forests?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sandalwood.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sandalwood** is the main species of moist deciduous forests.
 
• **Tropical Moist Deciduous Forest:**
 
 
• Present in the areas having rainfall between **100-200cm.**
 
• Found in** eastern slopes of the Western Ghats**, **foothills of the Himalayas in the North-eastern States, and Odisha.**
 
• Main Species of Tropical Moist Deciduous Forests: **Teak, Sal, Sheshum, amla, Kusum, Mahua, Sandalwood, etc**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Tropical Deciduous Forests:

 
 
• These are the most widespread forests out of all the types of forests in India.
 
• Also, called Monsoon Forests.
 
• They are found in regions having rainfall between 70-200cm.
 
• Tropical Deciduous Forests are further classified into two types of forests on the basis of rainfall- Tropical Moist Deciduous Forests and Tropical Dry Deciduous Forests.
 
 
 
• Tropical Dry Deciduous Forests:
 
 
• Found in the areas having rainfall between 70-100cm.
 
• Present in rainier areas of the peninsula and the plains of Uttar Pradesh and Bihar.
 
• During Dry seasons, Trees shed their leaves completely and the forest appears like a Grassland.
 
• Main species of Tropical Dry Deciduous Forests: Khair, Tendu, Palas, axle wood, bel, etc.
